title: Near-maximum search gives a vanishing-regret benchmark on fine payoff grids
checked_scope: A newly specified threshold search-and-uniform-fallback algorithm for iid uniform rational payoff grids with growing resolution.
significance: Derives exact stopping/fallback formulas and an O(sqrt(log n)/n) expected-regret guarantee with O(n²/log n) expected inspected pairs when the grid has at least n levels.
